name: Scrap Flats
design_intent:
SCRAP FLATS — THE SCRAPWORKS circuit's bare industrial ON-RAMP (tier 1; brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 §Scrapworks row 5). The validated flagship three-island / one-void skeleton with NO hazards at all: a grey scrapyard version of grassy geometry that teaches the two 680px gap-boosts and the recovery gamble before the circuit's hazard families arrive. One elevated SPRING THRONE over island C is the only vertical prize. Kill identity = knock rivals OFF an island into the bottom void -> off the screen. kill_shape = void_is_floor -> QA uses K1' (off-screen kills >= 88%).

GEOMETRY (symmetric flagship): three flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width lethal void: A x0..900 top1080 / B x1580..2480 top1080 (bubblegum, the calm centre) / C x3160..4060 top1080, separated by 680px void gaps. ONE spring THRONE x3640..4020 top560 over island C's outer-right, 520px above the islands (boost-only prize). Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (outer island edges 610px inside the side blast lines; 670px recovery sky under the islands). VOID READS AS DEATH via pit_void_rendering (dark bottomless gradient + canyon walls + hazard-red rim/chevrons + motes). Overcast grey open_sky (clouds off) = an industrial yard.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning: trampoline apex 270px / bubblegum 180 / spring apex 480; air_drift_max 340 => zero-boost reach ~395px trampoline / ~320 bubblegum / ~527 spring = MAX bounce drift; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s @ ~26 fuel, bounce refunds +20; super 2800 clears all but dumps the tank):
- GAP A<->B (island edges x900..x1580 = 680px over void): > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..x3160 = 680px over void): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the spring THRONE (top560): 520px above island C's top (1080). A trampoline apex 270 from C reaches only y810 (270px short); no floor spring exists. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED; an under-shot drops toward the void. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: island bottoms (1192-1208) to the bottom blast line (1878) = 670-686px of open sky over the void (>= 650) -> a fuelled knock-off boosts back (recovery gamble); a near-edge dead-on smash or starved victim rings out. Verb: FLY.
- Every required crossing (680px) exceeds a spring bounce's 527px reach and the throne sits > 480px above the islands, so NO route across or up exists without the jetpack. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.

SIGNATURE: the hazard-free scrapworks on-ramp — pure geometry so a new player learns the gap-boost rhythm on grey islands before the bumpers/drum/swings/hammers arrive.
